name: v-j-sync
description: Chạy backend + frontend cùng lúc cho môi trường dev

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
